properties.description: Spirited Away (2001), directed by Hayao Miyazaki and produced by Studio Ghibli, is an animated fantasy adventure featuring voices including Daveigh Chase, Miyu Irino and Suzanne Pleshette in its English-language release. The film follows a ten-year-old girl who falls into a hidden spirit world after her parents are transformed, and must work in a supernatural bathhouse to survive and save them. The narrative blends coming-of-age drama, folklore-inspired mythmaking, and environmental and anti-consumerist themes, delivered with evocative, emotionally resonant visuals and a sweeping score. Its tone balances wonder and melancholy as the protagonist grows through fear, courage, and compassion.

short_descriptions.value: A sullen ten-year-old wanders into a spirit world where her parents are transformed and she must work in a bathhouse to save them and find her way home.

properties.description: Spirited Away: Live on Stage is a theatrical adaptation directed by John Caird and featuring Kotaro Daigo, Kanna Hashimoto, and Satoshi Hashimoto. Presented as a family-oriented fantasy adventure, the production follows a young girl's journey into a spirit world where her parents are transformed and she must navigate strange creatures and tasks to save them. The staging relies heavily on puppetry, masks, dance, and a hidden orchestra to evoke the original film's visual imagination while emphasizing emotional growth and resilience.

Une jeune fille pénètre dans un monde d'esprits où ses parents sont transformés en cochons; elle doit affronter créatures étranges et épreuves pour les sauver et rentrer chez elle.

properties.description: Cast Away (2000), directed by Robert Zemeckis and starring Tom Hanks and Helen Hunt, is an adventure-drama with romantic elements about a FedEx systems analyst who survives a plane crash and is stranded on a remote island. Over years of solitude he learns to improvise shelter and sustenance, forms an unlikely companionship with a volleyball, and undergoes a profound emotional transformation. The film blends survival set pieces with intimate character study to examine isolation, loss, resilience, and the importance of human connection, and its tone is meditative and poignant.

properties.description: Drive-Away Dolls is a 2024 crime-comedy thriller directed by Ethan Coen and starring Margaret Qualley, Geraldine Viswanathan, and Beanie Feldstein. Set during a chaotic road trip, it follows two women whose attempt at a fresh start spirals into trouble with a group of inept criminals. The film blends queer romance, caper antics, and absurd violence with a mischievous, raunchy tone. It aims for a playful, offbeat energy that balances danger with irreverent humor.

properties.description: Flushed Away (2006), directed by David Bowers and Sam Fell, is a British-American animated action-adventure comedy starring Hugh Jackman, Kate Winslet and Ian McKellen. The film follows a pampered pet rat who is flushed into the sewers of London, where he teams up with a streetwise sewer rat to face a charismatic amphibian villain and navigate a bustling underground city. Combining slapstick set pieces and fast-paced action with warm themes of friendship, class contrast, and self-discovery, the movie mixes broad humor with affectionate British wit. The emotional tone is playful and energetic, appealing to both children and adults who appreciate clever visual gags and character-driven comedy.
